display_name: 六赛道断层轻量基线（P78 保留的 audited_v2 局部特征 logistic）

code_provenance.used_for: INLINE_3D/CROSSLINE_3D trace map and raw box reader

evidence.confirmation_task: P78 ①断层稳定冠军确认

license.training_data: unverified (Volve public release; licence text not checked in this package)

input_contract.source: one post-stack 3D SEG-Y (.sgy/.segy), read in place and never modified
input_contract.amplitude: raw float32, no normalisation at inference — this reproduces the P78 operational reference (predict_baseline_volume on raw ST10010). Training used z-scored ST0202R08 patches (mean -3.03e-06, std 0.02794), so raw ST10010 amplitudes are already outside the training scale.
input_contract.box: required: options.inline_range/crossline_range/sample_range (inclusive header numbers / sample index) or crop_start/crop_size in [Z,INLINE,CROSSLINE] index space; min edge 3, max 134217728 voxels

output_contract.fault_mask.npy: uint8 probability >= threshold (default 0.4505760073661804, validation_max_f1 from baseline_metrics.json)

applicability.trained_on: Volve ST0202R08 PSDM full-offset stack, z-score normalised 33×65 inline patches (baseline_metrics.json / build_summary.json)
applicability.domain: development-only. Inference follows the P78 reference exactly: raw (un-normalised) ST10010 amplitudes, i.e. a different survey and amplitude scale than training; the 0.4506 threshold was chosen on z-scored ST0202 validation data, which is why ~79% of the P30 box is masked positive. Any other survey is further out of domain.
applicability.known_quality: audited_v2 held-out test F1≈0.0155, precision≈0.0078, recall≈0.90 at the default threshold — a lightweight baseline, not a production fault detector

claim_boundary: 轻量基线/仅开发集验证：P78 未产生稳定冠军（SwinUNETR 阈值稳定门未过、权重未保存），因此保留 audited_v2 作为 operational reference。不宣称 frozen-test 泛化，不宣称生产级断层识别。

advanced_options.summary: SwinUNETR 等神经断层模型：P78 排名第一但阈值稳定门未过、权重未保存。
advanced_options.how_to_request: 询问“如何变强/提升精度”时告知：需要作为独立训练任务立项（本扩展包不重训、不带训练代码）。

submission_channel: api_only: POST /api/v1/prediction/tasks with seismic_path + explicit box; the unchanged frontend workbench submits snapshot-bound requests, which this extension rejects with 422
